name: World Trade Marketplace Economy
description: Rules, taxes, listing caps, and timing constraints governing peer-to-peer commerce across servers.

facts.listing_capacity: 10 lots maximum per account (includes active, sold pending claim, and expired)
facts.upfront_fee: 100% of listing price in Adena (Adena sink)
facts.sales_tax: 5% deduction on completed transactions paid in L-Coins
facts.settlement_window: 120 days to claim proceeds or recover expired goods

notes: 5% sales tax acts as systemic deflationary sink against currency buildup.

name: Eva's Shop Economy (Project Eva)
description: In-game store where premium advancement goods are acquired strictly through in-game gameplay points (Eva Points) combined with Adena.

sample_prices.cost: Eva's points x9,000 + Adena x2,000,000 [INFERENCE / PATTERN]

facts.design_philosophy: Eliminates pay-to-win real-money cash shop advantages in favor of active play metrics

notes: Provides the philosophical and structural foundation for Aden Arena's idle progression.

name: Macroeconomic Sinks & Faucets Architecture
description: Systemic balance of currency generation and destruction mechanisms across Lineage II Essence.

faucet_channels.channel: Junk / Loot Sales to NPC Vendors

notes: Critical balance equation: If Adena faucets exceed sinks, consumable prices and market inflation destroy early-game onboarding.
